_comment: Reviewed decisions to KEEP a name that an official document was read and does not carry — the third route DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md criterion 3 names beside a rename and a supersession.

A row is kept only while the node exists and still carries the name the row was written against; data_pipeline/verification/name_decisions.py refuses a stale row and the release gate mirrors the check.
A decision explains a negative; it does not remove it. The panel still says the page was read and does not carry the name. Nothing here is evidence that the unit exists.
Kinds: graphs_own_grouping (a grouping this graph made, which no document is expected to name); page_prints_another_wording (the page read headlines the unit in other words, quoted in `observed`).
The units whose curated name a complete committee list lacks are decided in list_dispositions.json (curatedNames), not here.

decisions.name: Independent Establishments & Government Corporations
decisions.basis: The graph's own grouping of the independent establishments and government corporations; the government prints no body of that name, and the page read for it (NARA's presidential-libraries index) is a page about one of its children.
decisions.observed: Presidential Libraries and Museums of the National Archives | National Archives

decisions.name: Judicial Support Organizations
decisions.basis: The graph's own grouping of the judicial branch's support organisations (the Administrative Office, the Federal Judicial Center, the Sentencing Commission); no official document names the set.

decisions.name: Specialized Federal Courts
decisions.basis: The graph's own grouping of the specialized federal courts; uscourts.gov's 'Court Role and Structure' page, the page read for it, describes them and does not use this name.

decisions.name: Congressional Support Agencies
decisions.basis: The graph's own grouping of the congressional support agencies; the Government Manual and the agencies' own pages name the agencies, not the set.

decisions.observed: Officers and Organizations of the House

decisions.name: Division of Information & Intelligent Systems
decisions.basis: NSF's own page for this unit (https://www.nsf.gov/cise) was read and headlines it 'Directorate for Computer and Information Science and Engineering (CISE)', the site's directorate-prefix convention, not the division's name as the graph writes it. The graph keeps the organisation-chart name; a rename to the site's heading would give the unit a name no NSF organisation chart uses (CURATION.md §9 declined the same case for the MPS divisions).
decisions.observed: Directorate for Computer and Information Science and Engineering (CISE)

The graph's name carries a dash-and-expansion typography no page prints; the unit is not in doubt and the wording is the graph's own convention, kept pending a rename the page would have to label.
